en.headline: Candidate Eligibility Committee rules 1115 Election Committee nominations valid
en.dek: The committee approved all ordinary election candidates for the 22 November poll, with 31 subsectors contested and five uncontested; ex-officio and nominated members were also confirmed.
body: The Candidate Eligibility Committee on Friday ruled that the nominations of all 1,115 candidates for the Election Committee subsector ordinary elections were valid.

The ordinary elections on 22 November will fill 982 seats. Of the validly nominated candidates, 856 will contest 723 seats across 31 subsectors, while 259 candidates in five uncontested subsectors are returned unopposed.

For the 156 seats filled by nomination from designated bodies, the returning officer received 40 nomination forms involving 161 nominees. Following the priority order set by the bodies, the committee validated 156 nominations and did not review the remaining five. It also confirmed the registration of 341 ex-officio members as valid.

An Electoral Affairs Commission spokesman said five ordinary polling stations will operate from 9am to 6pm on polling day. Combined voting arrangements will continue, allowing a voter who is also an authorised representative of another subsector to cast two ballots at the same station.

zh.headline: 資審委裁定1115名選委會界別分組選舉候選人提名有效
zh.dek: 委員會確認一般選舉候選人全部提名有效，11月22日選舉中31個界別有競爭、5個自動當選；當然委員及指定團體提名人亦獲確認。
body: 候選人資格審查委員會周五裁定，1115名選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉候選人的提名全部有效。
11月22日舉行的一般選舉將選出982個席位。當中856名候選人將競逐31個界別分組共723個席位，另有5個界別分組的259名候選人自動當選。
至於由指定團體提名產生的156個席位，選舉主任接獲40份表格、涉及161位獲提名人。資審會按團體列出的優先次序裁定156人提名有效，其餘5人的資格不作審查。委員會亦確認341名當然委員的登記有效。
選舉事務處發言人表示，投票日設5個一般投票站，由上午9時至下午6時。將繼續合併投票安排，界別分組投票人如同時為另一界別的獲授權代表，可於同一投票站投下兩張選票。
